channel.title: Blog of Mr Zaker Ullah
channel.description: Articles by consultant breast surgeon Mr Md Zaker Ullah FRCS

item.title: Lump behind the nipple in men: gynaecomastia or cancer?
item.description: A lump behind the nipple in a man is usually gynaecomastia, but male breast cancer does occur. A breast surgeon explains causes, warning signs and tests.

item.title: Can I see a private breast surgeon without a GP referral?
item.description: Self-funding patients can usually book a private breast surgeon directly. Insured patients normally need a GP referral. A consultant explains how it works.

item.title: The Rapid Access Breast Clinic at The Holly, Buckhurst Hill
item.description: A guide to the private Rapid Access Breast Clinic at Nuffield Health The Holly, Buckhurst Hill: booking, tests on the day, results and getting there.

item.title: Private breast clinic in Canary Wharf: a breast surgeon near work
item.description: A private breast clinic in Canary Wharf, explained by breast surgeon Mr Zaker Ullah: getting to Bank Street, employer insurance, self-funding and tests.

item.title: A second opinion after a breast cancer diagnosis: when it helps
item.description: A breast cancer second opinion can confirm a plan or open up options. A consultant breast surgeon explains when it helps, what to bring and timing.

item.title: Lumpectomy recovery: what the first six weeks usually look like
item.description: Lumpectomy recovery, from the day of surgery to six weeks: wounds, bras, seroma, arm exercises, driving, work and radiotherapy, from a breast surgeon.

item.title: Found a breast lump? What happens next
item.description: Found a breast lump? Most are benign, but none can be judged by touch. A breast surgeon explains triple assessment, one-stop clinics and when to be seen.

item.title: Five things every woman should know about breast cancer
item.description: A consultant breast surgeon's plain-English guide to breast cancer risk, the symptoms that matter, screening, and why outcomes are better than most fear.

item.title: What is oncoplastic breast surgery?
item.description: Oncoplastic surgery removes breast cancer and reshapes the breast in one operation. A consultant oncoplastic surgeon explains how it works and if it is safe.

item.title: Lipoma removal in Essex: assessment, the procedure and recovery
item.description: Lipoma removal in Essex explained by a consultant surgeon: which lumps need a scan first, NHS or private, local anaesthetic excision, scars and recovery.

item.title: NHS two-week wait or a private one-stop breast clinic?
item.description: How the NHS two week wait breast clinic pathway works, what a private one-stop clinic adds, and how to choose, from an NHS and private breast surgeon.

item.title: Fibroadenoma: should it be removed or left alone?
item.description: Fibroadenoma removal or monitoring? A consultant breast surgeon explains when a fibroadenoma can be left, when it should come out, and the options for removal.

item.title: Male breast cancer: the symptoms men should know
item.description: Male breast cancer symptoms explained by a consultant breast surgeon: the lump, nipple and skin changes to look for, who is at risk and how it is diagnosed.

item.title: Breast pain on one side: common causes and when to get checked
item.description: Breast pain on one side is usually hormonal, muscular or from the chest wall, rarely cancer. A consultant breast surgeon explains causes and when to be seen.

item.title: Bupa Open Referral: how to choose your breast surgeon
item.description: How Bupa Open Referral works for breast symptoms, what fee-assured means, and what to look for in a breast surgeon, explained by a consultant breast surgeon.

item.title: Nipple discharge: what clear, milky and bloody discharge can mean
item.description: Nipple discharge causes explained by a consultant breast surgeon: what clear, milky, green and bloody discharge usually mean, and when to be seen.

item.title: Private breast clinic near Woodford Green: The Holly explained
item.description: A private breast clinic near Woodford Green: getting to The Holly, what the appointment involves, insurance or self-funding, and how to book.
